# Copilot instructions (SGEL workspace)

## Project overview
- This workspace is a **content + design asset repository**, not a software codebase.
- Primary materials are layout/template files (InDesign/Illustrator/Photoshop/Word), PDFs, and instructional design documentation.
- Expect most edits to be **textual content updates** in Markdown, not code changes.

## Key directories and examples
- Instructional design doc: [guia-didactica-profesor-IA/ficha-diseno-instruccional-U03.md](../guia-didactica-profesor-IA/ficha-diseno-instruccional-U03.md)
- Design templates and assets: [brief-proposal-templates-2023-11-27-05-27-09-utc](../brief-proposal-templates-2023-11-27-05-27-09-utc), [Main File](../Main%20File), [Main 02](../Main%2002)
- Additional assets (images, PDFs, InDesign/PSD): repository root and subfolders

## Content conventions (observed)
- Markdown docs are in **Spanish** and structured by **BLOQUE** sections with numbered headings.
- Content uses **tables** with “Campo / Valor” or “Tipo / Descripción” columns.
- Many fields are intentionally **placeholdered with “*pendiente*”**; preserve this pattern unless the task explicitly fills them.
- Keep the existing section order and naming (e.g., “BLOQUE 1: IDENTIFICACIÓN Y CONTEXTO”).

## Editing guidance
- Prefer editing **Markdown files** for textual updates; avoid modifying binary assets unless explicitly requested.
- When adding content, mirror the style of [guia-didactica-profesor-IA/ficha-diseno-instruccional-U03.md](../guia-didactica-profesor-IA/ficha-diseno-instruccional-U03.md) (tables, headings, and vocabulary).
- Do not rename or move asset folders unless requested; paths are likely referenced externally.

## Workflows
- No build/test tooling is present in the workspace; there are **no discoverable CLI workflows**.
- Treat updates as **document edits** and focus on consistency with existing templates.
